cases.title: Valid login with an execution-scoped user
cases.description: A user created through the public API can sign in through the UI.
preconditions: The frontend and API are available
A unique synthetic user is registered for the test

steps.action: Open sign in and submit the generated credentials

expectedResults: The user is authenticated and visible in primary navigation

cases.title: Invalid login displays a useful error
cases.description: Invalid synthetic credentials are rejected without creating persistent authentication state.
preconditions: The frontend and API are available

steps.expectedResult: An invalid credentials message is displayed

expectedResults: Authentication is rejected with a visible error

cases.title: Create an article
cases.description: An authenticated generated user publishes a unique article through the UI.
preconditions: A unique synthetic user is registered and authenticated

inputData.article: unique synthetic title, description, body, and tag

steps.action: Publish a unique article from the editor
steps.expectedResult: The article detail and API persist all supplied fields

expectedResults: Title, description, content, and author are persisted

cases.title: Edit an article
cases.description: An authenticated author edits an execution-scoped article and verifies persistence.
preconditions: A unique synthetic user and article exist

steps.action: Open edit, replace article values, and publish
steps.expectedResult: Updated values persist in UI and API

expectedResults: The updated title, description, and content persist

cases.title: Create and delete a comment
cases.description: An authenticated generated user adds and removes a unique comment on an execution-scoped article.
preconditions: A unique synthetic user and article exist

steps.action: Post a comment and delete it
steps.expectedResult: The comment appears and is then removed

expectedResults: The comment lifecycle is visible in the UI

cases.title: Synthetic article deletion failure
cases.description: A controlled DELETE interception produces an HTTP 500 and a local simulated incident preview.
preconditions: A unique synthetic user and article exist

steps.action: Intercept only article DELETE and attempt deletion
steps.expectedResult: The controlled assertion fails and produces preview evidence

expectedResults: SIMULATED_DEMO_FAILURE is recorded locally and never reported externally
